title: Self-building Fortran hydraulic representation
question: Can SWAP5 build the selected F-AHL15 hydraulic representation internally from the authoritative B1.10 provider, freeze it, and amortize its construction cost over realistic repeated constitutive/solve use?
authority_rule: The builder samples the existing authoritative B1.10 provider. It must not introduce an independent hydraulic formula as source authority.

requirements: built representation satisfies frozen constitutive error gates under an independent dense validation
support count remains consistent with the selected Python research builder up to deterministic implementation differences
frozen representation is immutable during evaluation

measure: one-time build CPU per unique hydraulic parameterization
estimated break-even number of controlled Richards solves using F-AHL16 measured solve savings
stage_2.rule: Report measured build cost separately. Do not hide it inside cached runs.

cache_design.semantics: same fingerprint reuses immutable representation; changed authority or policy must miss the cache
